newsitem.title: USA: Dow seen higher at open in follow through.
newsitem.headline: Dow seen higher at open in follow through.

text.p: Wall Street was expected to head higher at the opening on Wednesday, following through on the previous day's blue chip rally.
But analysts said greater participation from the broad market and a steady bond market were prerequisites for sustained strength in today's trading.
"We're going to open on a mild note," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities. "We will probably follow through on a tentative basis. The rally yesterday was in the Dow."

"There will be a good deal of volaitility and investors will also be watching the two-year note auction today to see how well the supply will be absorbed," Wachtel said. "That will have an effect on trading in the afternoon."
